t_advice_summary_textbox.text: orange, green, red, blue gnomes take me to the light forest with the red basket, other colours take me to the dark forest with a yellow basket. Sizes of gnomes and hats are irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: When you start the game there will be gnomes that appear in pairs. Focus on red, green, blue and orange - these gnomes will take you to the bright forest.Other 4 colours - purple, brown, pink and yellow will take you to the dark forest.Mushrooms come in waves. When you feel like yorue onto a good streak of high mushrooms - stick with that colour block (dark forest gnomes or bright forest gnomes). Follow the trends, when you notice your mushrooms getting low when you are sticking with a certain group of colours - switch to the others. Ride the waves - follow the trend - trust your gut!
